import unicodedata

def is_palindrome(text: str) -> bool:
    # Normalize to NFKD form to separate accents
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', text)
    # Keep only alphanumeric characters, ignore case, and strip accents
    cleaned = ''.join(
        ch.lower()
        for ch in normalized
        if ch.isalnum() and unicodedata.category(ch)[0] != 'M'
    )
    # Empty string is a palindrome
    return cleaned == cleaned[::-1]
